name: First relay edge host admission and app-domain handshake
target: Loopback-only relay host pinning, public app routing, and the fake TLS-edge request path without live host or DNS changes
inputs: operator-pinned server ID and host signing public key
simulated public app host and HTTPS origin
local host connector with an app request handler
observations: trusted host authenticates and receives the app-localhost request
app response origin, host, and redirect are rewritten to the public HTTPS host
wrong host signing key is rejected before app dispatch
unknown user and invalid app hosts are rejected without calling an online host handler
unpinned public server ID and offline host fail closed
